results.name: detached buttons from a prior render cannot measure, hint or close a newer view
render(null) retires hidden same-version controls and restores opener focus
close retires immediately even when the owner callback does not rerender
old close control cannot close a newly reopened same-version panel
hint focus remains on the hint when a measurement inserts another button
close focus remains on close when the measurement list grows
measurement focus follows the recorded ID when list order changes
unchanged render retains controls and one valid dispatch
actual keyboard Enter activates a hint and Escape closes once with focus return
disabled/stale measurement cannot dispatch even via synthetic event
dispose retires controls and cannot be reversed by render
detached overlay host cannot dispatch or close
